key: Hang in there, Spoink.
en: Hang in there, Spoink.
ja: 頑張って、バネブー。

key: I know it's tough, but we'll find your pearl yet.
en: I know it's tough, but we'll find your pearl yet.
ja: つらいのはわかってるけど、きっとあなたの真珠を見つけてあげるからね。

key: Oh, hi there.
en: Oh, hi there.
ja: あ、どうも。

key: I'm in a bit of a pickle right now.
en: I'm in a bit of a pickle right now.
ja: 今、ちょっと困ったことになってて。

key: My Spoink lost its pearl!
en: My Spoink lost its pearl!
ja: うちのバネブーが真珠をなくしちゃったの!

key: Without their pearls, Spoink get really, really tired.
en: Without their pearls, Spoink get really, really tired.
ja: 真珠がないと、バネブーはものすごく疲れちゃうのよ。

key: I gave it this thing for until we can find the real one, but I haven't had any luck at all so far...
en: I gave it this thing for until we can find the real one, but I haven't had any luck at all so far...
ja: 本物が見つかるまではこれを代わりに持たせてるんだけど、今のところ全然運がなくて……

key: Huh-- you found Spoink's pearl?!
en: Huh-- you found Spoink's pearl?!
ja: え――バネブーの真珠を見つけてくれたの!?

key: There's no mistaking it; that's it!
en: There's no mistaking it; that's it!
ja: 間違いない、それよ!

key: Quickly!
en: Quickly!
ja: 早く!

key: There we go. All better.
en: There we go. All better.
ja: よし、これでもう大丈夫。

key: Thank you so much.
en: Thank you so much.
ja: 本当にありがとう。

key: Now Spoink should go back to normal!
en: Now Spoink should go back to normal!
ja: これでバネブーも元通りになるはず!

key: Um, here!
en: Um, here!
ja: あの、これ!

key: I was using this as a replacement, but I have no use for it now. So why don't you take it?
en: I was using this as a replacement, but I have no use for it now. So why don't you take it?
ja: 代わりに使ってたものだけど、もう必要ないから。よかったらもらってくれない?

key: I don't really know what that's about either, but at least I won't have to be responsible for it now.
en: I don't really know what that's about either, but at least I won't have to be responsible for it now.
ja: これが何なのかよくわからないけど、少なくとも、もう責任を負わなくて済むわ。

key: Hopefully you can find a use for it!
en: Hopefully you can find a use for it!
ja: あなたなら使い道を見つけられるといいけど!

key: Just hang in there a little longer...
en: Just hang in there a little longer...
ja: もう少しだけ頑張ってね……

key: I'll keep looking.
en: I'll keep looking.
ja: 引き続き探すから。

key: All better?
en: All better?
ja: もう平気?

key: Let's get back to training soon!
en: Let's get back to training soon!
ja: またすぐトレーニングを再開しましょう!
